Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Ιουλίου, «Οσία Ολυμπιάδα η Διακόνισσα», with the rank word and the title left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 25. јул ст. ст., „Св. Олимпијада ђакониса.“ — «Св.» is “saint” and «ђакониса» the grade, which is the `deaconess` in `types`, both left off by §6; the heading gives no by-name at all and «of Constantinople» in the display name is the corpus’s own. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so the bare form costs nothing here. The Serbian vernacular differs from the Greek Ολυμπιάδα and the Romanian Olimpiada this folder already holds, and nothing is transliterated.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 25 iulie — «Sfânta Cuvioasă Olimpiada»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Ιουλίου — «Οσία Ολυμπιάδα η Διακόνισσα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the woman is the folder's own: «Η Ολυμπιάδα έζησε στα χρόνια των Πατριαρχών Νεκταρίου και Αγίου Ιωάννου του Χρυσοστόμου (395 μ.Χ.)», the deaconess of Constantinople who gave her wealth to Chrysostom's archdiocese and died in exile at Nicomedia, against the Romanian «Sfânta Cuvioasă Olimpiada» of the same day. The Greek page adds the year «(395 μ.Χ.)» for the years she lived, which is why this upgrade proposes a `floruit` where the folder had no `dates` at all; it gives no year of her death, only that she was fifty and died a little after Chrysostom, so no `death` interval is proposed. It adds the title the day's line carries, Διακόνισσα, which the page repeats in the body — «Μέσα στην Εκκλησία είχε τον τίτλο της Διακόνισσας» — and that is the warrant for `types_add: ["deaconess"]`. It also adds her father's two names, Akoundos or by others Seleucus, her husband the prefect Nevridius, the suitor Elpidius whom Theodosius pressed on her, the monastery she founded by the church of Saint Irene, the seventeen surviving letters Chrysostom sent her in her mourning, and portions of her relics at the monasteries of Agathonos in Phthiotis and Ntaou Penteli. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn. Its name gloss is headed ΟΛΥΜΠΙΟΣ, the masculine form, and glosses that; the gloss is not taken as a name form.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.08.2026 (25. јул ст. ст.) — „Св. Олимпијада ђакониса.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (§4), and **the longest entry of this range**. «Св.» is “saint” and «%s» is the `deaconess` this folder already carries by §5; `venerable` and `monastic` beside it are not in the heading and are left alone. **The heading is one rank, one grade and a name**, so the bare forename is the whole of the form. **A FIRST DEATH YEAR, WRITTEN INTO A FIELD THAT WAS EMPTY, AND THE GROUND IS STATED BECAUSE THE DAY BEFORE REFUSED ONE.** The folder held `floruit` earliest 395, latest 395, display «395», basis traditional, and **no `death` at all**. This entry states one outright: „%s“ — she was driven out of Constantinople to Nicomedia, where she reposed **in the year 410**. `death` earliest 410, latest 410, display «410», basis traditional, the sentence in the note; `floruit` is **not touched**. **Why this is written where `christina-of-tyre`’s century was refused yesterday**: the rule is that a stated year fills an empty `dates` field and does not displace a recorded interval, and here the stated thing is a POINT, the field it fills is plainly empty, the `floruit` it sits beside is itself a point, and the resulting folder says she flourished in 395 and died in 410 — **fifteen years, a claim both books can carry**. Christina’s case was a CENTURY laid beside a twenty-year interval, which would have made her folder read as a life of a hundred and ten years, **a claim no book makes**. That is the test, and it is the first time this range has had to state it. **NO FOLD.** `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «%s» and `sr-foldpred.mjs` `new key, other holders: 0 (none)`. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND MOST OF IT IS THE EXILE. „%s“, born at Constantinople of very notable parents; „%s“ — **her father Анисије Секунд a senator, and her mother the daughter of that famous grandee Евлавије WHO IS MENTIONED IN THE LIFE OF SAINT NICHOLAS THE WONDERWORKER** — a cross-reference to another saint’s life, which is §6’s furniture case exactly and takes no row. „%s“, betrothed to a magnate who died before the wedding; „%s“ — in vain did **the emperor** and her kin press her to marry another, and she gave her inherited property to the churches and to the poor. „%s“, she served as deaconess first under the patriarch Нектарије and after his death under John Chrysostom. „%s“ — **when Chrysostom went into exile he counselled her to stay at the temple and serve the Church whoever should be patriarch after him**. Then „%s“: somebody set fire to the great church, the blaze took many notable buildings in the capital, **and Chrysostom’s enemies accused this holy woman of malicious arson**. „%s“ — her last charge was that **her body be put in a chest and thrown into the sea, and wherever the water cast it out, there she should be buried**; „%s“, the coffin was cast out at a place called Врохти where there was a church of the apostle Thomas; „%s“, great healing wonders from her relics down the centuries. **AND THEN THE LONGEST QUOTATION OF THIS RANGE, NINETY-THREE WORDS IN TWO RUNS.** „%s“, the exiled Chrysostom wrote the exiled Olympias fine letters which can still comfort all who suffer for God’s justice; and the entry quotes the sixth of them, „%s %s“ — he is glad not only that she is delivered from sickness but still more that she bears her troubles so nobly, **calling them trifles**, which belongs to a soul full of strength and abounding in the rich fruits of courage; for that she not only bears misfortune nobly but **does not even notice it when it comes**, without strain, without labour, without disquiet, not even telling others, but as though exulting and triumphing — that is proof of the greatest wisdom. **The entry cites the letter by number, «(Писмо VI)», which is the only numbered citation this wave has met in this book** besides the Apocalypse on the 20 July. **NO NEW `related`, AND FOUR PEOPLE TAKE NONE.** `john-chrysostom` is already on this folder and is the whole of the entry’s action; `proseprobe.mjs` reported him **OK**, the row standing both ways already. **The patriarch Нектарије GETS NO ROW**: `nectarius-of-constantinople` is a folder of this corpus and plainly the man, but his part here is one clause of chronology — she served under him first — and `proseprobe.mjs` returned no hit on him, so no test asks and no reading makes him a companion. Named for the author. **SAINT NICHOLAS THE WONDERWORKER GETS NO ROW**, being named only as the life in which her grandfather appears. **HER FATHER, HER GRANDFATHER, HER DEAD BETROTHED AND THE EMPEROR GET NONE**: `ls saints | grep -iE ’^anysius|^anisius|^eulab’` returns nothing at all, and the emperor is unnamed. **THE CHURCH OF THE APOSTLE THOMAS AT Врохти IS A DEDICATION** and a dedication is not a relation. No `office`: the heading gives a grade and not a see. No `locations`: Constantinople, Nicomedia and Врохти are named and none is written as a coordinate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. **TWO OF THE DAY’S FOUR ENTRIES ARE REFUSED WHOLE, WHICH IS THE HIGHEST PROPORTION OF THIS RANGE.** **ENTRY 1, „Света Ана.“, IS REFUSED ON §1 AND THE BOOK STATES THE GROUNDS ITSELF** — the second time in four days a §1 refusal has come with its own authority attached. `anna-the-righteous`, display name «Anna, mother of the Theotokos», already carries a venerated `serbian` row **on the Julian 9 September, written off this very book**, with the sr form «Анна», and is venerated on 9/9 by all four calendars with seven hymns on the folder. And the entry says so: „Данас се празнује њено успеније, но њен главни празник је 9. септембра, под којим је датумом написана и служба њена и житије.“ — **today her dormition is celebrated, but her chief feast is the 9 September, under which date her service and her life are written.** So the folder is not touched: no row, no name form, no `related`, no paragraph. **What this entry adds and nothing else in the corpus has**: „Ана беше из колена Левијева, ћерка Матана свештеника.“, Anna was of the TRIBE OF LEVI, the daughter of the priest Матан; and „После дугог и богоугодног живота упокоји се у дубокој старости.“, after a long life pleasing to God she reposed in a deep old age. The second-day note this would take under BRIEF.md’s Ruling is named for the author and is not written here. **ENTRY 4, „Спомен Петог Васељенског Сабора.“, IS REFUSED ON §4 AND §5 BOTH: A COUNCIL IS NOT A PERSON, AND THIS ONE ENUMERATES NOBODY AT ALL.** The commemoration of the Fifth Ecumenical Council: „Овај Сабор би у Цариграду за време цара Јустинијана Великог, 553. год.“, held at Constantinople in the time of the emperor Justinian the Great in 553; „На овом Сабору беху осуђене све јереси монофизитске, као и јеретички списи Теодора Мопсуетског, Теодорита Кирскоги Оригена (учење против васкрсења мртвих).“, and at it all the monophysite heresies were condemned, together with the heretical writings of Theodore of Mopsuestia, Theodoret of Cyrus and Origen — the last named for his teaching against the resurrection of the dead. **The only three people the entry names by name are the three condemned**, so there is no saint in it to make a folder of even if a Council were a person; and the Fathers of the Council, who are not named, are the standing case BRIEF.md’s Ruling calls one entry. **Justinian the Great is named and is not this entry’s saint**: `ls saints | grep -i justinian` was not needed, the heading being a Council.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Η Ολυμπιάδα έζησε στα χρόνια των Πατριαρχών Νεκταρίου και Αγίου Ιωάννου του Χρυσοστόμου (395 μ.Χ.)» — the one year the page prints for her. The same page says she died at Nicomedia «μόλις 50 ετών, λίγο μετά από το θάνατο του ιερού Χρυσοστόμου» and gives no year for it, so no death interval is recorded. The folder's Romanian source gave no year at all.

death.note: Охридски пролог: „Олимпијада би прогнана из Цариграда у Никомидију, где се упокоји 410. год.“
